items.quote: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
items.claim: The Israelites willingly brought offerings to the LORD for all manner of work commanded by the LORD through Moses.
items.actor: The children of Israel; every man and woman
items.object: a willing offering; for all manner of work
